ns2:course.label: The President and the People
ns2:course.description: A chronological survey of the American presidency that examines individual presidents and the times in which they lived. Major themes include: The creation and development of the office of the president; the nature of presidential power; Americans' evolving relationship with presidents; the impact of party politics, campaigning, and the media on the office.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Humanities - Hist & Phil, and Cultural Studies - Western course.
